card.name: Ocean instruments in reef-monitoring text
card.fires_on: Small words and punctuation (an, a, two, a colon) right before the name of an ocean measuring instrument, in a passage about reef oceanography sensors and moorings.

modes.label: Article before instrument
modes.description: The word an, a or two just before a sensor name such as Acoustic Doppler Current Profiler or sonar.

modes.label: Verb or colon introducing instruments
modes.description: A verb like installs, or a colon, that leads into a list of instruments.

modes.label: Start of instrument name
modes.description: The first piece of an instrument name, such as the C of CTDs or the Dr of drifting buoys.
